tasks.title: Симулятор: ограждение хоста oVirt
tasks.statement: Менеджер потерял связь с хостом и решает, что делать: мягко перезапустить VDSM по SSH, пропустить ограждение по политике кластера или выключить и включить сервер через управление питанием. В пяти ситуациях подберите настройки так, чтобы результат был правильным: не перезагружать живой сервер, не устраивать шторм перезагрузок и всё же перезапускать высокодоступные машины, когда хост точно мёртв. Упражнение решено, когда выполнены цели всех пяти ситуаций.
tasks.hint: Мягкое ограждение идёт первым. Политика «живая аренда» защищает рабочий хост, чьё управление сломано, а порог связи — кластер при отказе коммутатора: он должен быть выше доли одного упавшего хоста, но не выше доли упавших при аварии. Если контроллер питания мёртв, остаётся только аренда на стороне виртуальной машины.

scenarios.title: VDSM hung
scenarios.story: One host of four stopped answering because the vdsmd process hung. The server itself works, its VMs run, SSH answers.
scenarios.goal: Bring the host back to Up without a reboot
scenarios.hint: The cheapest step comes first: restart the service, not the whole server.

scenarios.title: The server died
scenarios.story: One host of four lost power. Its VMs are down, one of them is highly available. SSH does not answer, the controller works.
scenarios.goal: Switch the host off and on through power management and restart the highly available VM elsewhere
scenarios.hint: A VM may be started elsewhere only after the engine is sure the host is off. A threshold that is too low would also skip this case.

scenarios.title: Management network down
scenarios.story: The management network cable of one host is broken. The host is alive, its VMs work and write to storage over another network, SSH is unreachable.
scenarios.goal: Do not touch the host: fencing is skipped because of the live lease
scenarios.hint: A reboot of a working host would kill its VMs. The lease on storage proves the host is alive.

scenarios.title: The switch failed
scenarios.story: The management switch failed: the engine lost contact with 3 of 4 hosts. The hosts are alive, but the storage runs through the same switch, so leases cannot be read.
scenarios.goal: Skip fencing because of connectivity issues, without a storm of reboots
scenarios.hint: Three of four is 75%. The threshold must be low enough to skip this, but high enough not to skip one dead host out of four.

scenarios.title: The controller died too
scenarios.story: A host lost power together with its management controller: power management cannot reach it. A highly available VM was running on it.
scenarios.goal: Restart the highly available VM even though the host cannot be fenced
scenarios.hint: A VM with a lease on storage can be started elsewhere once the dead host stops renewing it.
